--ds-color-*Semantic roles. Use these in components.
--ds-color-primitive-*Foundations. Roles point at these; components do not.

Colour roles

The complete set of colours product code is allowed to use. Each role is a var() reference to a primitive, so re-pointing the primitive re-themes the product. Always reach for these.

Primitive colours

Raw palette steps and key colours. They exist so the roles above have a single source of truth. Referencing one of these from a component hard-codes a colour into the UI and breaks the theming contract.

Foundations only - do not apply directly

Contrast

Every on … role measured against the role it sits on, using the WCAG 2.1 relative luminance formula. This is checked on every build, so a role pointing at the wrong palette step is caught here rather than in review.

ForegroundBackgroundRatioAA body 4.5:1AA large 3:1
--ds-color-on-primary --ds-color-primary 9.78:1 pass pass
--ds-color-on-primary-container --ds-color-primary-container 9.71:1 pass pass

Findings

Produced by the same validation pass that fails npm run check --strict.

  • WARN --ds-spacing-large
    The spacing scale is not in ascending order: --ds-spacing-large is 18 but --ds-spacing-extra-large, listed before it, is 24.
  • INFO primitive colour collection.key colour group
    5 of 6 values in Key colours have no role pointing at them: secondary key colour, tertiary key colour, neutral key colour, neutral variant key colour, error key colour.
  • INFO primitive colour collection.neutral colour palette
    No colour role references Neutral palette (14 steps). It is a foundation with no semantic entry point yet.
  • INFO primitive colour collection.neutral variant colour palette
    No colour role references Neutral variant palette (14 steps). It is a foundation with no semantic entry point yet.
  • INFO colour roles
    No surface, background or outline roles exist. Components will have to reach for a primitive for page backgrounds and borders; consider adding `background`, `surface`, `outline` roles to the token set.
